display_name: 生成流源训练样本积分路径诊断
description: 冻结 E20、F0，比较原源 L_s/U_s 与 G10 L_s 的 1/2/4/8/16 步反向噪声轨迹，不读取类别标签、V/OE 或目标 IQ。
authorization: 用户要求探索更强恢复网络；已完成先导实验源验证波形误差大，授权对合法源训练输入做冻结路径诊断。

code.environment: N607 existing CVS-RFFI Torch, one admitted GPU, CPU2, FP32 and TF32 off

data.representation: Fixed first 128 original source R07 L_s, 128 U_s, 128 G10 L_s matched by exact physical ID, and the same 128 L_s clean; G10/R07 records may overlap, not new observations
data.physical_ids_ref: R07 source physical ID roles and G10 L_s IDs; F0 role contract equality
data.validation_ref: Completed E20 source checkpoint, role contracts and existing G10 L_s manifest
data.leo_config_ref: Existing R07 2.462 GHz view01 and fixed G10 2.45 GHz MIX01 source observations

permissions.regime: Frozen E20 and original Phase3 F0 on legal source training IQ only; no update, no label
permissions.claim_scope: Source-training sample path/step sensitivity and F0 prediction self-agreement, not TX accuracy, target selection or a performance guarantee

checkpoint.initialization: Frozen E20 flow and original frozen F0; no new optimizer
checkpoint.contract_check_ref: Exact E20 checkpoint commit/epoch/updates/roles and F0 original role IDs; G10/source L_s physical IDs matched
checkpoint.provenance_verdict: E20 F0-guided source model fixed, no heldout or target training; F0 retains supervised source knowledge
checkpoint.selection_rule: All five fixed step counts, same first 128 per group; no target data or classifier truth used

execution.gpu_policy: CPU controller and shared restoration admission lock; <=2 known goal workers, GPU4/6/7 free>=12GB and total compute PIDs<3; do not alter other jobs
execution.stop_rule: Mismatched source physical IDs, checkpoint/F0, nonfinite output or state update, output collision: fail, retain partial artifacts and do not blindly retry

metric_names: F0 clean/restored argmax agreement (not TX accuracy)
metrics_plan.prediction_ref: aggregate source training record metrics, no per-record TX predictions saved
metrics_plan.scorer_ref: direct no-grad frozen inference with input/reference and model state checks

rows.method: Same frozen E20 flow with identical opposite noise and fixed Euler step schedule
rows.seed_notes: Original E20 fixed inference template seed 2026110103, same source IDs/paths/steps, no random target data
rows.scenario: 128 records per fixed source group only
rows.budget_ref: E20/F0 synthetic-scope actual source smoke2, then 4 groups x128 x5 step counts x2 opposite paths; no optimizer/label/target

notes: Scientific trigger: fixed E20 source V nonclean IQ NMSE ~0.92 and target seven-view/Phase3 accuracy degraded; check source-training path integration rather than tune against held-out or target outcomes.
Source V, OE and target IQ not opened by this diagnostic. F0 argmax agreement is a clean-versus-restored consistency diagnostic and uses no TX truth.
G10 L_s first 128 only by physical-ID alignment; metadata for complete role IDs is audited. Two-source actual checkpoint smoke precedes full groups; no new records or neural updates.
Fixed F0 and E20 state snapshots, strict checkpoint ancestry, all 1/2/4/8/16 steps reported. Any subsequent candidate is separately preregistered; E30 already running unchanged.
Focused antithetic and identity metric test passed; independent review corrected over-reading G10 clean and GPU worker inventory before launch.
